title: Command API
what: The words of bmo-arbiter, one binary with no verb standing as the master and every verb beside it, and its exit codes, as docs/api.md states them.

title: Service clients
what: The clients the arbiter publishes: the Rust crate with every body and a call for every route, and the TypeScript package generated from the same OpenAPI document.

title: HTTP API
what: The routes both programs serve over HTTP, their bodies, pages, events and refusal codes, as docs/api.md and docs/openapi.json state them.

title: Lending protocol
what: The line protocol a borrowing engine's head speaks over the inner network: HOLD, STATE, QUIET, WANT, UNWANT, DROP, FETCH and SPACE, and the lines the arbiter says back, as docs/api.md states them.

title: Harness plugin
what: The bmo-arbiter plugin: the MCP server bmo-arbiter mcp and its seven tools, and the skill telling a harness when and how to use them, as docs/api.md states them.

title: Service contract
what: The way a service declares itself to the arbiter: a committed <service>.card.toml or a tool's [card] table, the adapter verbs it answers, and BMO_CARD_SERVICE in its processes, as docs/api.md states them.

title: Turn client API
what: The turn client offered to an occupant in a process of its own, imported as TurnClient, hold, GivingTurn and quiet, or run as a command around another command, as docs/api.md states it.
